reviews.text: Great place with amazing customer service.  I came into the store to treat a friend’s dog.  With no knowledge, I had multiple individuals helping me out.  I bought some of the doggie cookies (I hope that’s the right terminology) and my friend’s dog loved them.  Thank you for all the help and kindness.
Excellent service and great products. take my dogs to use the wash tubs

I was surprised by some of the prices, maybe a little out of my budget but did pick up some great finds under $11, very organized and have products I haven’t seen in any other pet stores. The dog cakes are so cute! If I lived closer, I would get my babies one for their special day!

Good customer service, affordable prices, good quality dog food. My dog loves the chicken feet here which you can’t find the fresh stuff they have anywhere else. Dog grooming price extremely affordable.

The only place I trust to make my dogs for a groom! Devonna is so good that my dogs vet has even complimented how good they looked. The rest of the staff is always so friendly and remembers not only my dogs but me without them.
My Dog Bertie is a little nervous guy, and we were so happy to see the love and patience he got at Natural Pawz, Ashley was amazing with him, we will absolutely be bringing him back
Ashley did such an amazing job grooming my dog, Lita! Will definitely be coming back!

I want to thank Anna for her care and patience with Fiona, who is very timid.
She is my most precious treasure, and I love seeing her do well. Congratulations, Anna!!! ♥️🐶♥️ …

I previously gave four stars because I used the self-service station for my dog, and it was always a great experience. Today, I wanted to share my experience bringing in our new little kitten for grooming.

As first-time cat owner, I was not sure how to handle everything, so I decided to take our baby to the salon. The technician was incredibly understanding and helpful. She patiently answered all of my questions and made us feel comfortable throughout the entire process. She did an amazing job with our little one, and we truly appreciate her care and professionalism.

We will definitely be coming back for our kitten’s grooming appointments. The self-service area is also fantastic—especially in the summer. The place is quiet, super organized, and very clean.

I highly recommend this spot. It’s one of the best in Houston!
I’ve taken my dog to Hailey several times now, and she always does a great job grooming him. I’m really happy with her work. She’s also super nice and friendly.

Friendly and Knowledgeable Staff!  If your dog has tummy sensitivities, they can help you find the right food!  They also have grooming and a self-wash.  The patio out front is adorable, with seating and water for my Pup.  Great place to get treats too.
First time and they did absolutely amazing!!! The groomer really took the time with Millie and gave her the best bath and brush. Staff is very attentive and kind. We will be coming back.

Dog wash stations were dirty, towels they give you are not clean anymore and the shampoo over diluted. This establishment used to be great and my go to, ever since they closed the other location in 2024 this place has been slowly getting worse. I was also told I can’t use my own brush at the was station since it would make a mess. I thought the whole idea was to pay for this service to avoid the mess at home lol. It is reasonably priced and good enough if you are needing to use the dog shower in a pinch. The amount of inventory, treats and dog collars is great and well priced as well. I did have a bad experience this time though
Very clean place and staff was very friendly and knowledgeable

Ms.Corinthia and Ms. Megan are awesome, always ever so courteous and helpful. Good and knowledgeable suggestions on dog food , treats and toys . I have been a returning customer since I began to go there about six months ago.
Hailey is great! My dog loves her and always looks amazing and smells so good!

Don’t go to petsmart or petco - come here so you can get better quality food and treats for your cats and dogs. Extremely helpful and I appreciate the care they take into every aspect of the store.

Wonderful service from staff in store to make sure I found what I needed - they also provide many freeze dried snacks I give onyx (cat) at an affordable price so I don’t have to wait on Amazon anymore.

Every time I go in to thos store I find another treat or toy that my dog loves. Today they had an open house, and they had cavier for dogs, and my puppy Jake loved it. The folks working here are extremely nice and helpful. They showed me how everything in the dog wash area works and I look forward to using this in the future after going to the dog park.

Everybody was so nice and customer friendly and my dog was treated like royalty I love the happiness they spread even with the animals this is a place to go and I will keep going back because they are customer friendly
Love this place. Super friendly and knowlegable staff. Great selection of pet products. We found our groomer here thanks to numerous recommendations!

The place is very clean and organized, with cute decor. There was no wait time for my scheduled appointment which was appreciated. The customer service, however, needs a lot of improvement as well as the groomer's receptiveness to feedback.

The staff here is absolutely amazing. They're so excited to see your pet and help you find anything you need. I've been bringing my dogs in for nail grinds as well and the groomers have done a great job without cutting the quick. My dogs are never stressed to go back to the groomers which is very important to me. I also appreciate that they opened up for a couple hours during the last freeze to make sure their neighborhood would have pet food.

They carry a wide variety of interesting food options and alternative diets for pets, which is perfect if you’re looking for something beyond the usual brands.

The staff was very cordial and helpful. They took the time to answer questions.

Great costumer service from Corinthia and Poppy. They were very friendly and helpful with booking services. They answered all of my questions in a timely manner and my pet is happy.  The prices are reasonable for a full grooming service.
The atmosphere is very relaxing and the pets look happy to be there. Plenty of yummy treats for your furry family member.

Eunice did a great job with our dog bath, de-shedding, and nail trimming services! Our dog can be difficult to handle, so we're extremely appreciative of her care and attentiveness. Thank you, Eunice!

Update Jan 2026
Stellar groomer.
Efficient service. Much improved.

we have been going to Natural Pawz  for years, first in Montrose and then when they closed, to this one here on Washington. Always, until now, a great experience - as we go regularly to wash our dog. something has chnaged recently, perhaps a change in management - and it is run like a business, very badly at that, with no customer service, poor accountability and basic neglect of stewardship for such a previously good brand. They instituted a new policy where we have to call first for a self-service dog bath (!) . so we called first at least 3 times to get an appointment and no answer, phone just kept ringing. we finally went in and the person at the counter did not know what was wrong so she got the manager who was abrupt rude and failed to help in any way. if it were not our having pre-paid several baths, we would definitely find someplace else. BAD Natural Pawz, Bad!
Always well stocked!

The experience was extremely disappointing due to poor communication and service. This business was recommended to me, which is why I chose to try it, but the experience did not meet expectations. Before leaving, Ana felt my dog’s coat, discussed the requested haircut, and explained that matting would be an extra charge. I made it clear that my dog is brushed daily, asked her to check thoroughly, and explained that the only sensitive areas were around his eyes and mouth. Despite this, I was contacted after I had already left and told he was matted, without being shown or consulted beforehand, even though I specifically asked to see any issues before any cutting was done.
My dog remained there for about four hours with no updates, and I had to call the salon myself for information. When I picked him up, the haircut was not what was agreed upon and appeared uneven and poorly done. The promise to save his hair was not honored, and my dog did not look or act the way he normally does after grooming.
I also felt uncomfortable being pushed to switch services, and the pricing did not align with the level of care provided. Overall, this felt like a lack of transparency and consideration, especially given the high cost, and left me feeling that my concerns and expectations were disregarded. I do not recommend taking high-maintenance coat dogs here.

Eunice always does a great job grooming my dog. You can tell she cares about the pups and is very knowledgeable. Everyone at the store is always so kind to us when we come in. I will be continuing my dog’s regular grooming here with Eunice and will continue to shop here for all his needs. Happy to support a local small business. Highly recommend to all
The last Natural Pawz in Houston. That makes me so sad. I hope they remain open.
I love this place! Everyone is so nice and they know my dog (Sugar) by name. They always do an amazing job on her haircuts and Sugar loves playing with her friend Snow ☺️

I called to ask for some information, and the staff was incredibly kind and helpful. Since the store is right in my neighborhood, I stopped by and was assisted quickly and warmly. It was the first time my dog Buzz didn’t cry while getting his nails trimmed that alone says a lot! The prices are very reasonable, and the service was excellent. We’ll definitely be coming back!
Exceptional grooming experience for a reasonable price. Helpful customer service with easy scheduling.
They always take the best care of my pups! And help identify problems. I trust them!

The selectiom of fresh baked treats, b-day cakes and products in astonishing! Staff is very friendly, plenty of parking area, easy access, their self service wash is well equipped, and the prices are fair! I'm giving out 4 stars, just because of lack of gathering detailed info for grooming when dropping your furry friend. But overall they are great!!

Eunice has been grooming my dog for a few years now and she is the best! He struggles with anxiety, and she is so caring and makes sure he feels comfortable. His haircuts are always the best when he’s with her too!
Favorite pet store

Eunice is the best groomer!! My dog is a rambunctious puppy and Eunice did an excellent job regardless. She listened to every thing I asked for including cleaning paws, ears, trimming nails. Thank you so much for being so careful

I got there 15 min before close on a Saturday and was trying to hurry. The employee was being so kind and reassuring me I did not need to rush and she was happy to help me! That is so rare in this day and age! She helped to find ways to save and even helped look through their sale stuff to make sure I got the perfect birthday present for a friend's dog. I had met the staff before at fun dog events through out Houston and have started to routinely drive from across town just to shop with Natural Pawz.
Great shop to find food you can't get at the big stores! Friendly staff and a good selection of products for both dogs and cats.
Great selection of quality products
Great locally-owned pet supply store. Nice selection of items for dogs and cats. Staff is always friendly and willing to help.
Clean store, friendly staff knowledgeable people self wash is very easy to use well-maintained and well stocked with dog care products. Products are high-quality and reasonably priced.

The staff are always friendly and informative. I go there for our dog food. The food we use is in stock. Last time I was there I scored some "red tag"/discounted items. I like the dog treats section too.  I haven't used the grooming services.
Was out of puppy food and desperately searching for the brand (Nutrisource). They have a whole wall dedicated to this brand and very friendly staff. Got a discount and free puppy treat sample too!

I took my dog to get a bath and a shed treatment. It’s a convenient location because it’s in my neighborhood and I can walk there. They said it would take between 2-3 hours, however, it only took an hour. When I got home, I noticed that her rabies tag had been chewed up. I called and asked about it and they claimed it was that way when she (my dog) got there. I know it wasn’t. They said she must’ve chewed it up while she was wearing it. It’s basically a choker so tell me how that’s possible?

I looked online to see how much it would cost to replace the tag and the Internet said between $1- $5 dollars. No big deal, but that’s not the point. If you make a mistake, own it. Because now I’m writing a bad review and I’m going to run my mouth to my dog friends. I’ll take my dog and her tag someplace else out of the way.

They didn’t apologize or anything just straight up blamed me.

I’m so grateful we found Eunice, a fantastic groomer! Eunice has been amazing with my puppy Mia from day one. You can tell she genuinely loves my puppy. She takes the time to ask if there’s anything specific Mia needs each visit, which I really appreciate.

What really stands out is how comfortable Mia is now with grooming. She used to be nervous about baths, but thanks to Eunice’s gentle and caring approach, that fear is completely gone. It’s such a relief knowing Mia is in such good hands.

Highly recommend to any pet parent looking for someone who truly cares.

Love this place! I get my dog’s grooming and food from here. I also frequently go to the self wash which is so convenient and they provide everything you need from shampoo to towels. Devonna does a great job with the grooming, highly recommend!
Always a pleasant shopping experience. All the folks here are knowledgeable and helpful.

I brought my puppy to get her nails cut at NaturalPaws and Liz Tyler was absolutely amazing! When my puppy was scared, Liz Tyler handled it like a pro and got her nails clipped in less than a minute. Highly recommend!

I had a great experience at this pet store, even though they were short-staffed today. Liv, the employee who was cutting my dog’s nails, was incredibly professional and calm, even when my dog unexpectedly bit her. She handled the situation with so much patience and understanding, reassuring me that it was no big deal and that she would be happy to try again when my dog was ready. It’s clear that Liv cares deeply about both the animals and their owners, and I truly appreciate her dedication. I’ll definitely be back! So sorry again Liv.
Great spot! Self wash station is so convenient, and they provide all the supplies you need. Liv and her team are so nice and welcoming. This message was approved by our dog

First time taking my kitty cat blue for nail trim, paw pads shaving, & ear cleaning services and devonah (hope I spelled that right sorry) was gentle & experienced with my blue. She did so well with him & made me feel like she knew what she was doing. Only took 15mins! Liv in the front gave me welcoming customer service to & helped answer all of my questions. We will be back next month! Thank u everybody.
We had Liv groom our pup today!  She did a great job!  Happy to have had her services.
They can usually fit my Honey in for a nail grind. My favorite pet supply location.
Great Store 4Dogs..Trimming n Accessories
Love coming here for everything from my dog’s monthly bath to supplements or treats. The staff has always been super friendly and helpful.

We took our baby here to get groomed. We have been customers of natural pawz in their west gray location for a long time but since that one is closed we decided to go to the one on Washington Ave. We gave our baby to a new groomer whom we didn’t know and fully trusted her. When we got him back, we noticed his tail was bleeding profusely. When we asked her what happened, she shrugged and said I have no idea. She left it like that. My poor Happy still had a lot of bleeding happening. We took him to the vet immediately and they informed us that the groomer made a hole in his tail.

Edited:

They totally owned up to the mistake and corrected it. I appreciate them for reaching out to make sure Happy was cared for. Natural Pawz will retain my business ❤️ thank you once again for making things right
My puppies love the food available here, Open Farm brand and My frenchie’s allergies went away when I switch to this food. Thank you Natural Pawz!
Great service, good food for doggies

I could not have found another place
That had advised me so well.
Amazing stock. I tried the groomer..
How great. She did my dogs nails
Just like I wanted then. My fur baby
Really took to her. Love this place.
Was told they would need to completely shave my dog to at her grooming appointment. I took her to a reputable place that said it would not be necessary at all and they did a great job.

I have been a regular client of Natural Paws Heights. After their closure I made an appt with my regular Groomer  Ashley at the Washington location. I went for my appt and they switched my groomer without notice. I said that was not going to work so they said I could wait come back later or come another day. Anyway I left very irritated. I have now learned they are doing this often.  So if you have a specific groomer beware. I don’t think I will go back.
Try calling 30 mins before they close and no one answers and if they do, you’re put on a hold until they close! Way to lose business!
My girl Ashley is the best !!

Such a cute store! And by far the best self service dog wash I have been too! I used to be a professional dog groomer so I was pleasantly surprised to see the blow dryer they have is on par with what I used to use. Makes blow drying so much …

Finally found a self dog wash that was reasonably priced for my >100lb dog. The dog wash station was well stocked for each station (2 total), we were even given extra shampoos for the amount of fur we were dealing with. Staff is helpful and …

I do miss the Montrose / Westheimer location,  much more convenient for me & it always seemed pretty busy.
But this location the employees are just as nice & that goes a long way when I …
